plain: A rumor holds that in 1954 President Eisenhower made a treaty with the greys, small grey-skinned beings of UFO lore, letting them collect biological specimens and run medical experiments on Americans. Michels tells it as 'lore' on several shows, calling it the Greada treaty and saying Eisenhower used a dentist visit in Palm Springs as cover while the deal was done at Edwards Air Force Base. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says Eisenhower met the Nordics, tall human-looking beings, first, and that the greys 'made him a better deal'. An author named Peter Levenda brushes it off as the idea that 'Eisenhower or somebody' signed a contract with aliens in the 1950s.
